findings.result: Numbered filenames are explicitly mapped from published slugs. The adapter resolves inside data, verifies number/slug, flattens every heading/paragraph in order, and keeps the optional aside, both edition notes and all historical source mappings outside the main body. Unexpected Chinese reading keys or section keys fail closed. Source digests use the complete original JSON bytes, not a duplicate corpus.

The opt-in book_material checks preserve the presence or absence of the optional aside, complete note/coverage counts, and exact historical source URLs in their original order. Titles and reading material must be nonempty and cannot inject raw HTML. These are structural guards, not a claim of literary or semantic review.

Optional asides are closed details after the complete body, with generic localized related-SAE labels and existing native destinations. Edition notes and real historical source links are included together in their own details. Article JSON-LD uses the complete historical citation URL array, not an invented shared SAE paper. Schema citation-array handling was verified by actual code reading; no unapproved complete draft page was rendered to exercise it.

western-prose extraction matches the actual three div reading modes, whose nested content uses sections/paragraphs rather than nested divs. Complete-main protection independently includes optional asides, edition notes and historical references. Existing primary pages and canonical JSON match the pre-expansion baseline.

The western builder adds new language header links only if a real publication receipt exists and require_review_seal succeeds. The Descartes profile requires explicit approval and a review seal. The foreign renderer checks the seal before creating its page mapping. No receipt or approval was mocked for this audit; the unsealed Descartes foreign page renderer was not invoked.

The review-preparation helper now resolves body and notes by zero-based unit index, aside by the complete string, sources.title by zero-based source index, and other metadata as before. It verifies each issue.after against the saved target before sealing. No seal was prepared or written in this audit.
